$comment: Invariant ids owned by the P1 task `p1-day-freeze-recovery` (packages/core/src/day/**, packages/core/src/streak/**). REQUIRED OF THE INTEGRATE TASK: merge every docs/owned/*.json into docs/invariants-owned.json, which is the ONLY file `pnpm test:coverage-map` reads. docs/invariants-owned.json is outside this task's file lane, so until that merge happens test:coverage-map still owns only P0's six ids and would not notice if any of the 28 below lost its test. Until then the local gate is packages/core/src/day/__falsifiers__.test.ts, which fails if any id here is missing from the registry or from a test name in day/ or streak/. INV-DAY-01 and INV-DAY-05 are P0's and stay owned there; this task must not regress them, and day/rollover.test.ts carries a test for each showing the whole-day-boundary walk still obeys them.
falsifiers: packages/core/src/day/__falsifiers__/<id>.json, one per id, loaded by the test that owns the id and gated by packages/core/src/day/__falsifiers__.test.ts
alsoRequestedOfIntegrate: packages/core/src/index.ts (owned by another P1 task) must re-export './day/index.js' and './streak/index.js', or none of this engine is reachable as `@freelingo/core`.
